decisions.reason: The source changes when the no-referral mint confirmation modal appears, not how fiat buyers access commissions, tickets, prizes, or dashboard information.
The referenced transaction is the no-referral commission-and-ticket distribution transaction, not the separate optional tip transaction.
Modal sequencing after random reward distribution does not change fiat-wallet creation, custody, key control, or setup requirements.
The source does not change the Transak provider, fiat conversion, supported payment methods, or automatic mint behavior.
The no-referral confirmation modal's timing relative to reward distribution does not alter the USDC approval or NFT mint flow.
The source contains no change to the $15 mint price, pricing commitment, fees, or refund semantics.
The source changes only confirmation timing and does not modify the $5 founder, $5 affiliate, and $5 prize-pool allocation.
Waiting to show a no-referral success modal until reward distribution completes does not change the NFT ebook product or unlimited-mint model.
The source concerns a no-referral reward-distribution transaction and does not change ETH conversion, exact-output swapping, or refund behavior.
Confirmation timing does not change which payment methods are selectable or unavailable.
The source does not change wallet-currency selection or currency-disclosure requirements.

The source assumes that the random commission and ticket distribution occurs and changes only when its confirmation modal appears; the allocation trigger, amount, recipient selection, and first-mint exception remain unchanged.
